title: Universal homeomorphism of algebraic stacks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] in the universe convention of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal X,\mathcal Y$ be algebraic stacks [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack] over $S$ and let $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ be a morphism. Use their point spaces $|\mathcal X|,|\mathcal Y|$ of field-valued objects and the point maps induced by morphisms [def-sfb-dm-stack-morphism-properties], with the smooth-atlas topology [def-sfb-stack-point-topological-space], which is independent of the atlas and makes induced point maps continuous by [lem-sfb-stack-point-topology]. Using the $2$-fibre products of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids], call $f$ a universal homeomorphism when, for every algebraic stack $\mathcal Z$ over $S$ and morphism $g:\mathcal Z\to\mathcal Y$, the canonical projection induces a homeomorphism $|\mathcal Z\times_{\mathcal Y}\mathcal X|\to|\mathcal Z|$. There is no representability, separation, finite-type or Deligne--Mumford condition on $f$.
